_comment: Copy into the work dir as clone-config.json (gitignored). Read by scripts/build_section.py. Keys starting with _ are notes and ignored.
_slug: Short id: becomes sections/ppc-<slug>.liquid, snippets ppc-<slug>-c1/h1/j1, template product.ppc-<slug>.json.
_source_url: Reference page (layout source). Used to resolve relative font URLs and to warn if its name leaks into the page.
_image_map: Reference image URL (no query) -> YOUR Shopify CDN URL. Default to your OWN product media. Any image left pointing at the reference store is reported.
_gallery: Your CDN image URLs in display order. Non-empty = rebuilt scroll-snap gallery (replaces their swiper). Empty = keep their gallery HTML.
_gallery_class: Class(es) for the rebuilt gallery wrapper so their layout CSS still applies. Shopify Dawn-like: 'grid__item product__media-wrapper'.
_wrappers:
Their outer divs (open, close) so descendant selectors like '#app .v-product .container' still match. Shopify Dawn-like example: ['
', '
'].
_font_urls: Font file name -> your Shopify Files URL (after staged upload). Shopify CDN sends CORS *, the reference store usually does not.
_shop_pay: true = render YOUR store's real Shop Pay button + installments line in light DOM, projected via <slot name="ppc-pay"> / <slot name="ppc-terms"> (add those slots with html_fixes). Requires Shop Pay enabled on your store.
_mix: Multi-style products only (omit or null for single-variant). tiers = [qty, percent, badge]; default_tier = index preselected. Percents MUST match the automatic discounts you create in stage 6.
_related: Add the ppc-related section (products from metafield ppc.related). Hidden automatically when the metafield is empty.
_social_proof: Replaces the reference's invented counters with REAL data (sections/ppc-social-proof.liquid): 'Only N left' from tracked inventory, 'X in <state> purchased' from shop metafield ppc.recent_orders (real paid orders, real times). Nothing shows when there is no real data. Omit or null to leave it out. See SKILL.md 'Real-data social proof'.
_drawer: Overrides for ppc-cart-drawer settings in this template, e.g. {"tiers": "2:10,3:15,4:20", "accent": "#222222"}. insurance_handle / insurance_percent default from store.json.
_exit_popup: Optional: {"code": "WELCOME10", "percent": 10, "list": "<ESP list id>", "hide_group": ""}. brand + klaviyo_key come from store.json. The discount code must exist first (confirm with the user).

html_fixes.why: Chinese platform: their express-pay buttons belong to their store -> our BUY IT NOW (or <slot name="ppc-pay"></slot> with shop_pay).
GUARDRAIL: never reproduce third-party rating badges / review counts from another store.
GUARDRAIL: never copy the reference store's name, logo or domain.
Shopify source: make their ATC a plain button the cart drawer intercepts.
Shopify source: KEEP their sticky add-to-cart bar (must come BEFORE the buynow rule - same SectionAtcBtn id).
Shopify source: sticky bar button -> adds 1 of the selected variant.
Shopify source: their Buy It Now.
Shopify source + shop_pay: their accelerated checkout -> our real Shop Pay button.
Shopify source + shop_pay: their installments line -> ours.
Shopify source: 'Style - <value>' label follows the selected variant (option index 0).
Shopify source: third-party bundle/quantity apps and pickup widgets do not work outside their store.
Shopify source (Dawn-like): the 3 CSS fixes - grid min-content overflow, flex-row ATC container, rem in inline styles (.625 = reference root 10px / your theme root 16px; adjust). See SKILL.md.

_html_fixes: Ordered regex rules applied to the buy-box HTML (Python re, DOTALL). Each rule: {pattern, replace, why} or [pattern, replace]. The example mixes Chinese-platform and Shopify-source rules - keep only those that match your reference page and check the printed match counts (0 = rule did nothing).
